name: Popcorn Express
notes: Kettle corn company run by Duane Tanaka in Honolulu, in business since 2008 per its BBB profile. The website URL comes only from a MapQuest listing (sameAs field), and I did not open the site itself. No Instagram or Facebook page was found that clearly belongs to this business. Third-party listings show two different Honolulu addresses (Lawelawe St and Kuwili St). The only market-stop info I found was in a Yelp review, which I did not use. No current schedule found.

name: Special Gifts by Clarice
notes: Gift basket and baked goods business owned by Clarice Hamada at 820 6th Ave, Honolulu (Kaimuki), since 1983 per BBB. The website URL appears only on a MapQuest listing, which also shows a different Kalihi address; another directory lists no website. I did not verify the site. No social accounts found. I could not confirm whether it is currently operating.

name: Sugar HI
notes: Business name is Sugar HI Hawaii. A Star-Advertiser article from Oct 2024 gives the Instagram handle @sugar.hi.hawaii and says the business pops up at the Plenty of Aloha farmers market at Windward Mall (Kāneʻohe) on Wednesdays and Sundays. The article says orders are in person only and tells readers to follow Instagram for updates. The article is about two years old, so I could not confirm the schedule or that it is still active. I did not find it on the current Plenty of Aloha vendor list. It is not Sugar Sugar Hawaii, which is a jewelry and clothing boutique.

name: Sweet Treats by Kris
notes: The site says 'Visit us at pop-up events across O'ahu' and sells products online with shipping. A Star-Advertiser piece from Apr 2026 says owner Kris Louie moved from a storefront to pop-ups. Plenty of Aloha's vendor page lists it at both the Kaimuki and Windward Mall markets. The Facebook page is labeled 'Diamond Head', which was the storefront. It has posted event schedules, but I could not see the date of the latest one, so check it before relying on it. No Instagram handle was found.

name: Sweetened by Kristel
notes: Listed on Plenty of Aloha's Kaimuki Market and Windward Mall Market vendor lists. Also listed by Shop Small Hawaii (Cafes + Desserts) and on an earlier Kapālama Kai market vendor list. I treat it as active because it appears on the organizer's current vendor list, though I could not see the list's date. I found no Instagram, Facebook or website that clearly belongs to this business.

name: Tasty Jerky Hawaii
notes: Based in the Mililani Shopping Center at 95-221 Kipapa Dr, Mililani (central Oʻahu). It has a USDA-inspected facility (grant date Apr 2024). The Facebook page lists store hours and posts pop-up days, for example a Pearlridge Center post. The website lists products and a free-shipping promotion, so I used it as the order URL. The Honolulu Festival 2026 vendor listing also links the same website. No Instagram found.

name: Ugly Stix
notes: Honolulu maker of thin beef jerky, beef and turkey sticks and dried fruit. The Facebook page lists the same Square site and email. It announces craft fair stops, but the latest post visible in search was a Mother's Day gift fair at Ka Makana Aliʻi. That post is about 18 months old, so I could not confirm current activity or schedule. The Square store lists shipping terms, and at least one item shows as out of stock. No Instagram found.

name: Uncle T's
notes: The only evidence is that 'Uncle T's' appears in a vendor list on the Plenty of Aloha site, which runs windward-side farmers markets. I could not tell which market it sells at or what it sells. No website or social accounts found. I did not use Uncle Bobo's (Kaʻaʻawa) or Uncle's Ice Cream (North Shore), as nothing ties them to this vendor.

name: Wananao Coffee
notes: The business spells its name Wana'ao (Wana'ao Kona Coffee). Its site lists a Honolulu address and phone and says it sells only online and at a local farmers market. The Hawaii Farm Bureau page lists it at the Saturday Honolulu Farmers' Market at KCC, and says it was formerly Happy Cakes. That page is about 21 months old. The coffee is grown on the Big Island, but the vendor is Honolulu-based. I could not confirm current activity or whether it still sells at KCC. No Instagram or Facebook found.

name: XOXO Pastry
notes: The website lists menu items and prices for cheesecakes and desserts and takes event inquiries. A Marketspread vendor profile also exists (https://marketspread.com/vendor/260790/xoxo-pastry/). TikTok posts from about a month ago, from other accounts, say it is at Windward Mall Farmers Market (2nd floor) on Wednesdays 2-6pm and Sundays 10am-2pm, and in Hawaii Kai on Mondays. The business's own TikTok handle appears to be @xoxo.pastry, but I found no Instagram account I could tie to it. The Instagram account @xoxo_patisserie is a different business, so I left Instagram null. The schedule comes from third-party posts, so I left schedule_source_url null.

name: Aloha Acai
notes: Food truck on Mehana St next to Windward Mall in Kāneʻohe (46-038 Kamehameha Hwy), opened Sept 2024 by sisters Uilani and Kehaulani Ho. A Star-Advertiser article from May 2026 profiles it, and a 2025 article says Tuesday-Saturday 11am-5pm. No own website or social account found, so those are null. It is not HI Cravings Windward or Aloha Salads.

name: Aloha Espresso
notes: Coffee cart at 56-505 Kamehameha Hwy in Kahuku, next to the Giovanni's shrimp truck, established 2014. Some third-party listings flag it as closed or out of business, but I found no confirmation from the owner or a news source, so I left still_active null. No own website or social accounts found. I did not use review-site content.

name: Aloha Mac Shack
notes: Food truck at the Ohana Hale Waikiki food truck park, 1958 Kalākaua Ave. A Star-Advertiser article from Nov 2024 gives the Instagram handle @alohamacshack and says orders are in person or via DoorDash. The website URL comes from a third-party listing and I did not open it. The order URL is an Uber Eats listing, not the business's own channel. Hours reported in 2024 may have changed, and a TikTok post mentions a Monday stop on Lewers St. I could not confirm the current schedule or that it is still operating. No Facebook found.

name: Aloha Shrimp
notes: Shrimp truck at 53-534 Kamehameha Hwy, Hauula, phone 808-387-7394, per the Localicious Hawaii listing (about 5.7 years old). I found no own website, Instagram or Facebook page, and no recent news, so I could not tell if it is still operating. It is not Shrimp Shack or Giovanni's.

name: Aloha Smash Burger Waikiki
notes: I ran out of search budget before searching for this vendor, so nothing was verified. The only mention I saw was an 'Aloha Smashburger Waikiki' tag on a TikTok topic page, which does not tie it to a specific account. No website or social accounts found.
